_comment: Loss function profiles for BinaryTradeProfitabilityLoss. Select with --loss-profile. 'alpha' (class weights) is computed automatically from the training label distribution — do not add it here.

default._comment: High-precision bias. Penalises false positives heavily via pr_weight and profit_weight.

balanced._comment: Equal precision/recall weight. Good starting point for new instruments.

high_recall._comment: Catches more entries at the cost of lower precision. Useful if the label set is sparse.
